"import cadquery as cq

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Closed profile with fitted spline — 2D sketch on the XZ plane (mm)
#
# LOCAL sketch coordinates (u, v) map to GLOBAL (x, y, z) = (u, 0, v):
#   local u -> global +X
#   local v -> global +Z
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

P = cq.Plane.named("XZ")

# ----- Entity 1: Line from (30, 0) to (-6, -19) -----------------------------
a_start = P.toWorldCoords((30, 0))
a_end = P.toWorldCoords((-6, -19))
line_1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(a_start, a_end)

# ----- Entity 2: Line from (-6, -19) to (-30, 0) ----------------------------
b_start = a_end                      # (-6, -19) — shared junction
b_end = P.toWorldCoords((-30, 0))
line_2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(b_start, b_end)

# ----- Entity 3: Fitted spline through the fit points (in order) ------------
fit_points_uv = [
    (-30, 0),   # start (shared with line 2)
    (-18, 30),
    (-6, 23),
    (6, 31),
    (18, 15),
    (30, 0),    # end (shared with line 1)
]
fit_points = [P.toWorldCoords(uv) for uv in fit_points_uv]
spline = cq.Edge.makeSpline(fit_points)  # smooth interpolation, no kinks

edges = [line_1, line_2, spline]

# ----- Deterministic closure verification (coincident junctions) ------------
TOL = 1e-6
def _coincident(v1, v2):
    return (v1.sub(v2)).Length < TOL

assert _coincident(line_1.endPoint(), line_2.startPoint()), "junction 1 not coincident"
assert _coincident(line_2.endPoint(), spline.startPoint()), "junction 2 not coincident"
assert _coincident(spline.endPoint(), line_1.startPoint()), "junction 3 not coincident"

# All entities must lie on the XZ plane (y == 0)
for e in edges:
    for v in e.Vertices():
        assert abs(v.Center().y) < 1e-7, "entity not on XZ plane"

assert len(edges) == 3, "must be exactly 3 curve entities"

# ----- Export: compound of edges -> sketch.step ------------------------------
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
